posts.en:
dsh-remote-ssh-ops is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-95a1cad25e976a97d355.html
